contractVersion.description: Strict semver contract version carried by every wire object. Decoders accept the same major version; any other version is a typed error.

denials.description: Typed denials the adapter MUST surface with their reason codes — every denial is explicit, never silent.

action.description: The denied action scope (open vocabulary, e.g. `reality:write`, `evidence:submit`).

reasonCode.description: Stable denial reason code (open vocabulary; advisory well-known values: not-authenticated, forbidden-role, missing-permission, cross-tenant, revoked, expired). Rendered verbatim.

reasonDetail.description: Human-readable supplement; never replaces the stable reason code.

grantedActions.description: Action scopes the server grants (open vocabulary; e.g. `reality:read`, `evidence:submit`). Server-decided; the client never extends this list.

subjectRef.description: The principal/session this authorization context is about.

validUntil.description: When the server's authorization answer expires, when stated.
